summary: This is the Python SDK for runtime 493, where gamma deposits are spent by their own hotkey. SpendGamma now takes a service hotkey and an amount and is signed by the deposit's hotkey, and the new gamma_spent read returns what a hotkey has spent at a service. SetGammaDepositSpender, btcli gamma set-spender, and the mint spender and service-hotkey options are removed, and a daily spend cap must be zero or at least 0.1 gamma. Earlier SDKs cannot mint, spend, or read gamma deposits once runtime 493 is live, so upgrade before using gamma.
